title: Systems Integration Engineer
description:
**Your Role**
 The Systems Integration Engineer designs, develops, and maintains scalable integrations between enterprise systems (primarily SAP ECC) and advanced digital platforms, enabling reliable data access for AI\-driven use cases and backend smart solutions.
   

  

 The role ensures data connectivity is secure, standardized, and aligned with enterprise architecture.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
* Design and implement system integrations between ERP platforms (primarily SAP ECC) and downstream applications, enabling seamless and reliable data exchange for business and AI solutions.
* Develop and maintain data access layers and interfaces (e.g., APIs, middleware, data services), ensuring high availability, scalability, and performance of integrated systems.
* Enable AI and automation use cases by structuring and exposing ERP data in a usable and governed manner for advanced analytics and intelligent platforms.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (e.g., Product Owners, Solution Architects, Data Engineers, Automation teams) to translate business and technical requirements into integration solutions aligned with enterprise architecture.
* Ensure data integrity, security, and compliance across integrations, adhering to internal standards, data governance frameworks, and IT security policies.
* Manage and resolve integration incidents and defects, proactively monitoring interfaces and ensuring continuity of critical data flows.
* Document integration solutions and data models, supporting maintainability, knowledge transfer, and audit readiness.
* Drive continuous improvement of integration frameworks, identifying opportunities to standardize, automate, and optimize data connectivity across systems.


**To Suceed You Will Need**
* Education level
+ Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field

* Relevant Previous experience (minimum years of experience to competently carry out the role, not total year of experience)
+ Proven experience in system integration, middleware, or backend development (typically 3–6\+ years)
+ Hands\-on experience integrating ERP systems, preferably SAP ECC / SAP S/4HANA

* Knowledge areas/Skills (minimum level of knowledge to fullfil the role’s responsibilities)
+ Strong understanding of data integration concepts (APIs, ETL, middleware, event\-driven architecture)
+ Experience with SAP integration technologies (e.g., ABAP interfaces, IDocs, RFCs, OData, BAPIs)
+ Knowledge of integration platforms/tools (e.g., SAP PI/PO, SAP BTP, MuleSoft, Azure Integration Services)
+ Familiarity with data structures, databases, and data modelling
+ Programming/scripting experience (e.g., Python, Java, SQL)

* Other requirements (e.g. Language skills; competencies; expected travel requirements)
+ Strong problem\-solving and analytical mindset
+ Ability to collaborate across business and IT teams globally
+ Fluent in English
+ Understanding of data governance, security, and compliance principles
+ Experience supporting AI/analytics use cases through structured data provisioning is a strong advantage
+ Experience working in Agile environments.


**In Return We Offer You**
 The Atlas Copco Group serves customers through innovative compressors, vacuum solutions, generators, pumps, power tools and assembly systems. We are a global and diverse Group of many strong brands and around 34 000 employees representing different cultures in more than 180 countries. We have a wide range of positions so whatever your interests or area of expertise, we offer interesting challenges and the opportunity to grow.

We believe that people make it happen and with us you are empowered to act. Your ideas can make a real difference and contribute to the quality of life for people everywhere.

* Hybrid work arrangement: 3 days in office

description:

 Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business.
   

  

 Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing:**
 Job Summary:
   

  

 As a Database Administrator, you are a recognized technical expert responsible for the end\-to\-end performance, availability, security, and cloud modernization of critical enterprise database and data platform systems. You support and maintain database migration projects, engineer high\-availability architectures, perform deep performance diagnostics, integrate database operations into modern DevOps/DataOps and Data Engineering workflows, and contribute to Fabric/Azure data platform maturity. You bridge database administration and engineering teams raising the technical standard of the team.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Lead complex administration and optimization of mission\-critical SQL Server and Azure SQL environments; architect and configure Always On Availability Groups, geo\-replication, Azure failover groups, and HADR workflows to meet RPO/RTO objectives.
* Lead database migration projects (on\-premises SQL Server to Azure SQL Managed Instance, Azure SQL Database, or IaaS), utilizing Azure Database Migration Service (DMS) and hybrid network integration patterns.
* Perform advanced performance engineering: deep wait\-stat analysis, blocking/deadlock mitigation, complex T\-SQL tuning, Query Store and Extended Events diagnostics, and index strategy redesign.
* Implement and enforce advanced security controls: Always Encrypted, Dynamic Data Masking, Row\-Level Security (RLS), Azure Key Vault integration, Purview sensitivity labeling, and STIG/SOC 2 baseline configurations.
* Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployment pipelines using Terraform or Bicep; integrate database schema migrations and deployments into Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows.
* Configure and operate Microsoft Fabric workspaces, Lakehouses, Warehouses, and integration pipelines; manage Fabric capacity scaling, workspace access models, and operational support runbooks.

**Ready to take your career global?**
 Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a Database Administrator Specialist to join the ever evolving Infrastructure Services team and help shape the future of global commerce.

We’re responsible for running some very critical systems, maintaining 20,000 servers via an automation platform, thousands of databases and petabytes of storage hosted from our data centers and public cloud.
   

  

 The Database Administrator Specialist is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining enterprise‑grade Oracle and PostgreSQL databases and supporting infrastructure. This role includes installing, configuring, and upgrading Oracle and PostgreSQL servers; managing users and access controls; monitoring and tuning system performance; troubleshooting database issues; and ensuring high availability, reliability, and security across both platforms.
   

  

**What You'll Bring**
* Proficiency in Oracle database technologies, including strong hands\-on experience with RAC, ASM, performance tuning, high availability, backup, and recovery. Solid understanding of Oracle Database architecture across versions 18c, 19c, and 23ai\*, along with working knowledge of command\-line utilities, file systems, networking, and database security features.
* Oracle Exadata hands\-on experience and strong understanding of core Exadata features such as Smart Flash Cache, Storage Indexes, Hybrid Columnar Compression (HCC), and IORM. Proven troubleshooting experience across RAC, ASM, Exadata infrastructure, performance tuning, and Oracle Data Guard (physical and logical), including Data Guard Broker. Experience with Exadata full‑stack patching and upgrades is desired.
* Security expertise: Understanding of security best practices and compliance related to databases that are essential for securing databases and protecting against cyber threats.
* Problem\-solving skills: Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills are necessary for diagnosing and resolving database issues efficiently.
* Communication skills: Effective communication skills, both verbal and written, are important for collaborating with team members, documenting system configurations, and providing technical support to end users.
* Experience with automation scripts, problem solving, Container Databases (CDB) and Pluggable Databases (PDB).


**It’s a bonus if you have**
* Proficiency in PostgreSQL database technologies, hands\-on experience in performance tuning, high availability, backup and recovery, and replication.
* Good understanding of PostgreSQL architecture across versions 12, 13, 14, 15, and 16, including deployments such as standalone instances, streaming and logical replication, and HA frameworks (e.g., Patroni).
* Experience supporting on‑premises environments as well as cloud‑based deployments (including managed PostgreSQL services).
* Working knowledge of command\-line utilities, Linux file systems, networking, and PostgreSQL security features.
* Knowledge of PostgreSQL internals, Ansible, OEM and AIOps.
* Certifications: Relevant certifications such as Oracle Certified Professional (OCP), Oracle Certified Expert (OCE) or Oracle Certified Specialist (OCS) are looked at favorably.

 Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career.  Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.

description:
**Company:** 
 Alliance Bernstein
   

  

**Website:** 
 Visit Website
   

  

**Business Type:** 
 Enterprise
   

  

**Company Type:** 
 Product \& Service
   

  

**Business Model:** 
 B2B
   

  

**Funding Stage:** 
 IPO/Public
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Fintech
   

  

**Salary Range:** 
 ₹ 50\-70 Lacs PA
   

  

**Job Description**
**Job Description Summary**
 We are seeking
 ***VP Database Operations Manager***
 to join our
 ***GTI ( Global Technology Infrastructure)***
 in Global Technology \& Operations.
   

  

**Team/Group Description**
 This position operates in a fast\-paced, innovative, and globally distributed environment with On\-Call responsibilities for critical incidents. If you are a passionate technical leader with deep SQL Server, Oracle and Azure expertise, strong automation capabilities, and a desire to drive excellence within the DBMS Operations group, this role offers an outstanding opportunity to lead enterprise database strategy and deliver transformative business value
   

  

**Role Description**
 The Enterprise Database Operations Lead is a senior technical leadership position responsible for directing the database administration team and ensuring the high availability, security, performance, and scalability of enterprise database platforms across the global organization. This role combines hands\-on expertise in relational database management systems (strong emphasis on Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL in Azure, Oracle and Sybase) with strategic oversight and team management to drive operational excellence, innovation, and alignment with business objectives in a fast\-paced, mission\-critical environment.
   

  

**Applications And Business Or Enterprise Functions The Role Supports**
 Working closely within the Global Technology Infrastructure group, the candidate will collaborate extensively with various support groups, such as Unix and Windows Administration, Storage Management, and global application support teams. This role underpins support for mission\-critical enterprise RDBMS systems, that include financial trading systems, accounting, brokerage, business intelligence and advanced analytics, regulatory compliance and data governance, customer\-facing applications, and disaster recovery/business continuity operations. By maintaining robust, high\-availability database infrastructures, optimizing performance at scale, and enabling seamless data integration, the role minimizes business disruptions, supports real\-time global decision\-making, powers enterprise\-wide reporting and analytics, and enables strategic initiatives such as cloud platform modernization, large\-scale data platform modernization / migrations, and adoption of advanced data services
   

  

**Key Job Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**
* Leading, managing, and mentoring a team of Database Administrators within the DBMS Operations group, including performance evaluations, coaching, resource planning, and fostering a high\-performance, collaborative culture centered on knowledge sharing and continuous technical growth.
* Serving as the organization’s primary subject matter expert on database platforms, diagnosing and resolving complex issues, establishing and enforcing best practices, and ensuring rapid, effective incident response to maintain minimal business impact.
* The candidate will be responsible to manage scalable, resilient database solutions, including advanced high\-availability configurations, disaster recovery strategies, and integration of modern technologies—in close partnership with the broader DBMS Engineering group and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Developing and maintaining sophisticated automation frameworks using advanced scripting (PowerShell, T\-SQL) and tools (SQL Agent \& ControlM scheduler) to streamline critical operations such as backups, patching, monitoring, alerting, capacity management, and routine maintenance.
* Collaborating intensively with application development, infrastructure, and business teams to optimize database design, query and indexing strategies, performance tuning, and application\-database integration while safeguarding data integrity and compatibility.
* Driving proactive performance and tuning, capacity planning, monitoring, and bottleneck resolution using enterprise\-grade tools to deliver optimal system efficiency and reliability.
* Championing knowledge transfer, technical training, and continuous improvement initiatives within the DBMS Operations group; analyzing performance metrics and trends to identify and implement impactful enhancements.
* Providing strategic technical guidance and roadmap input to the enterprise application teams on database platform evolution, including Azure cloud adoption (IaaS/PaaS), platform upgrades/migrations, and evaluation of emerging data technologies to support long\-term organizational objectives.


**What Makes This Role Unique Or Interesting**
 This role combines strong technical leadership with operational responsibility inside the Global Technology infrastructure team, giving you real influence over our enterprise\-scale data infrastructure.
   

  

 You'll gain deep expertise in advanced data server management, large\-scale automation, and modern observability/logging systems — while guiding a talented team through complex, high\-impact challenges.
   

  

 With global scope, mission\-critical systems, and the chance to shape the future of our DBMS strategy, this position bridges hands\-on operations with strategic business impact. It's both highly rewarding and intellectually stimulating.
   

  

**Professional development value of this role**
 Working within Global Technology Infrastructure group this role accelerates growth in advanced technical domains (SQL Server high availability/business intelligence stack, Azure PaaS/IaaS database services, enterprise automation, performance and tuning, Database Virtualization \- such as Delphix) and observability, while significantly strengthening leadership, stakeholder management, and strategic planning capabilities. You will gain experience leading in a sophisticated, global operations environment, handling enterprise\-scale complexity, and driving innovation in cloud and data platform modernization. These experiences position the candidate exceptionally well for future advancement into senior roles such as Senior DBMS Architect, Cloud Data Platform Lead, or broader data/infrastructure leadership positions.
   

  

**Job Qualifications (The Ideal Candidate Should Have The Following)**
 The ideal person will work closely within the DBMS Operations group and should possess:
   

  

* Demonstrated success leading large\-scale, global or multi\-site database environments with strong emphasis on high availability, performance optimization, capacity planning, and mission\-critical system reliability.


**Qualifications, Experience, Education**
 The ideal person will work closely within the DBMS Operations group and should possess:
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
* 15\+ years of progressive, hands\-on experience in database administration and engineering, with at least 3 years in a leadership or team lead role managing database professionals in an enterprise setting.


**Skills**
* Proficiency across RDBMS platforms (Microsoft SQL Server primary; Oracle, PostgreSQL, with some knowledge of Sybase \& IQ, Redis Cache experience beneficial)
* Expert knowledge of SQL Server technologies, including Failover Clustering, AlwaysOn Availability Groups, Log Shipping, SSIS (Integration Services), SSRS (Reporting Services), and SSAS (Analysis Services).
* Advanced programming skills in PowerShell and T\-SQL for sophisticated automation, scripting, and query optimization; familiarity with .NET development is advantageous.
* Strong experience with performance monitoring and management tools (e.g., SCOM, Foglight, or equivalent enterprise solutions). Knowledge in database virtualization techniques such as Delphix
* Deep understanding of Windows Server, Linux and Solaris operating systems.
* Proficiency with Cloud (Azure) technologies, including IaaS and PaaS database offerings, virtual machine sizing, disk and storage management, and related cloud infrastructure components.
* Knowledge of Splunk and other logging/observability technologies for centralized monitoring, alerting, and root\-cause analysis.
* Advanced SQL skills for complex data manipulation, performance tuning, indexing strategies, query plan analysis, and optimization.


**Soft Skills And Other Requirements**
* Exceptional communication skills, with proven ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences (engineers, architects, executives, and non\-technical stakeholders), produce clear documentation, and facilitate productive cross\-team collaboration.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset, rapid adaptability in high\-pressure situations, and the ability to balance independent initiative with effective teamwork.
* Preferred certifications: Microsoft Certified: Microsoft SQL Server\-related certifications, Azure Database Administrator Associate (or equivalent), Oracle Certified Professional (OCP), or relevant Azure/AWS cloud database certifications.

title: Data Quality Engineer
description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on
 **Data Quality Engineer / Quality Engineering Lead** 
 to join our Data, Analytics \& AI organization in Pune.
 



 The role will be responsible for ensuring that data, analytics, reporting, and AI\-enabled products are
 **accurate, reliable, scalable, secure, and production\-ready** 
 . You will work closely with business, product, data engineering, analytics, technology, and Data Platform teams in India and the U.S.
 



 You will own the end\-to\-end quality engineering lifecycle — from requirements and test strategy through test automation, data validation, defect management, release certification, and production validation.
 



 This is a highly technical role suited to someone who is comfortable working with
 **large datasets, complex enterprise systems, SQL, data pipelines, Power BI, APIs, cloud platforms, automation frameworks, GitHub, and CI/CD environments** 
 .
 



  





**Key Responsibilities :** 




  





 1\. Quality Engineering \& Test Strategy
 


* Partner with Product, Engineering, Analytics, IT, and Business teams to define quality standards, acceptance criteria, and release\-readiness requirements.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive testing strategies and quality frameworks for Data, Analytics \& AI products.
* Translate business requirements into structured testing approaches covering functionality, reliability, performance, data quality, and usability.
* Own independent regression testing and release certification.
* Lead defect triage, root\-cause analysis, prioritization, remediation tracking, and release sign\-off.
* Establish risk\-based testing approaches and ensure appropriate quality controls are applied throughout the development lifecycle.



 2\. Data, Analytics \& BI Testing
 


* Independently test and validate
 **KPIs, business metrics, data transformations, semantic models, dashboards, reports, and analytical products** 
 .
* Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, reconciliation, and integrity across source systems, integrations, data warehouses, data lakes, and reporting environments.
* Perform advanced SQL\-based data validation using complex joins, subqueries, CTEs, window functions, and other data\-quality techniques.
* Test enterprise reporting and analytics platforms, including
 **Power BI and governed semantic models** 
 .
* Identify data\-quality issues and work with Data Engineering and Data Platform teams to perform root\-cause analysis and drive remediation.
* Validate that analytical solutions perform reliably and consistently in production environments.



 3\. Test Automation \& Quality Engineering
 


* Design, build, and maintain automated testing frameworks for Data, Analytics, and AI products.
* Develop automation using technologies such as
 **Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, PyTest, TestNG, JUnit** 
 , or equivalent frameworks.
* Integrate automated testing into
 **CI/CD pipelines** 
 to enable continuous testing and faster, more reliable releases.
* Drive automation\-first and shift\-left quality engineering practices.
* Establish testing metrics, quality KPIs, defect trends, automation coverage, and other measures of testing effectiveness.
* Continuously improve testing processes, frameworks, tools, and engineering practices.



 4\. GitHub, DevOps \& Release Management
 


* Establish and maintain GitHub repository standards for Data, Analytics, and AI solutions.
* Support repository management, branching strategies, pull requests, merge validation, release tagging, and source\-control governance.
* Integrate automated quality checks and testing into
 **GitHub Actions and CI/CD pipelines** 
 .
* Partner with engineering and delivery teams to ensure appropriate quality gates are incorporated into release processes.
* Support release validation, deployment readiness, and production quality controls.



 5\. AI \& Advanced Analytics Validation
 


* Independently test AI\-enabled applications, recommendation engines, predictive solutions, and Generative AI use cases from a quality, reliability, integration, and production\-readiness perspective.
* Validate data flows, application behavior, integrations, performance, and operational reliability of AI\-enabled solutions.
* Partner with analytics and data science specialists who own model accuracy, statistical validity, and business/model outcomes.
* Ensure AI\-enabled solutions meet defined functional, technical, and operational quality standards before production release.



 6\. Lab\-to\-Factory \& Production Readiness
 


* Act as the
 **quality owner for solutions transitioning from Innovation Lab/PoC environments into production or Factory environments** 
 .
* Define and manage Factory Acceptance Criteria covering functionality, data quality, performance, governance, supportability, monitoring, and operational readiness.
* Review test evidence, deployment plans, support documentation, monitoring processes, and quality metrics before production approval.
* Provide independent quality sign\-off for production readiness.
* Partner with Factory and production teams to ensure solutions can be supported, monitored, maintained, and scaled effectively.



 7\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration
 


* Work closely with U.S.\-based business, technology, product, analytics, engineering, and Data Platform stakeholders.
* Communicate testing outcomes, quality risks, defects, dependencies, and release\-readiness clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Build strong working relationships across geographically distributed teams.
* Support data\-driven and risk\-based decision\-making through transparent quality reporting and objective testing outcomes.



  





**Required Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* **8–12 years of overall experience** 
 , with at least
 **6 years in Quality Engineering, QA, Data Testing, Test Automation, or related roles** 
 .
* Strong experience as a Senior Individual Contributor, Lead, or Quality Engineering Lead owning testing strategy and release quality.
* Experience testing
 **enterprise data, analytics, BI, reporting, data engineering, ML, or AI solutions** 
 .
* Advanced SQL skills, including:
* Complex joins
* Subqueries
* CTEs
* Window functions
* Data reconciliation and validation
* Hands\-on experience testing
 **Power BI, dashboards, semantic models, governed datasets, and enterprise reporting solutions** 
 .
* Experience testing:
* Data warehouses
* Data lakes
* ETL/ELT pipelines
* APIs
* Data integrations
* Business rules
* Strong experience building and maintaining automated testing frameworks.
* Experience with one or more automation technologies such as
 **Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, PyTest, TestNG, or JUnit** 
 .
* Experience with
 **Azure DevOps, GitHub, Jira, CI/CD pipelines, and release management** 
 .
* Hands\-on experience with
 **GitHub Enterprise** 
 , including repositories, branching, pull requests, merge validation, release tagging, and source\-control governance.
* Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, quality governance, release management, and defect management.
* Experience performing root\-cause analysis and partnering with engineering teams to resolve data and application\-quality issues.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience working within an enterprise
 **Data, Analytics \& AI organization** 
 .
* Experience with one or more of the following:
* Microsoft Fabric
* Databricks
* Snowflake
* Azure Synapse Analytics
* Azure Data Factory
* Azure Data Lake
* Experience implementing
 **DataOps, AnalyticsOps, MLOps, or Quality Engineering** 
 practices using GitHub.
* Experience testing AI/ML solutions, recommendation engines, predictive models, or Generative AI applications.
* Experience validating semantic models, business metrics, master data, metadata, and governed analytical assets.
* Experience with
 **Lab\-to\-Factory, PoC\-to\-Production, or Product Industrialization** 
 models.
* Experience working with enterprise\-scale data and analytics platforms.
* Relevant certifications such as
 **ISTQB, Agile Testing, Azure, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, or Quality Engineering** 
 certifications are a plus.

 AI Powered Tech Talent
   

  

**Role Summary / Description**
 Senior Engineer role in Knowledge Engineering focused on designing, building, and leading significant workstreams for enterprise\-scale Knowledge Graph, semantic layer, ontology, and AI knowledge solutions on Microsoft Azure. In this role, the successful candidate leads a substantial knowledge engineering scope within a large program, translates real\-world business problems into scalable AI and KG solutions, guides technical direction, and contributes to thought leadership, reusable assets, and delivery standards. The role must bring relevant industry experience across domains such as BFSI, healthcare, retail, telecom, manufacturing, energy, public sector, or life sciences, applying semantic AI, knowledge graphs, LLM grounding, data pipelines, and cloud\-native engineering patterns to deliver measurable client value.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Engineer Azure\-based knowledge engineering solutions using services such as Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse/Fabric, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, AKS, Microsoft Purview, Entra ID, APIs, and Azure Monitor.
   

  

 Build graph ingestion pipelines, semantic data products, vector integrations, LLM grounding layers, APIs, and governed access patterns on Azure while improving performance, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.
   

  

 Lead the build of Knowledge Graph solutions that transform client data architecture within a large program scope.
   

  

 Direct the design, development, and implementation of AI, semantic layer, ontology, taxonomy, schema, graph modeling, and knowledge curation solutions, ensuring all components work together seamlessly.
   

  

 Work with project leaders, delivery leads, client stakeholders, architects, data engineers, AI engineers, product teams, and domain SMEs to create standout graph\-powered data and AI offerings.
   

  

 Develop strong client relationships, earn trust as a key advisor, and explain the business value of semantic layer, ontology, and knowledge graph solutions.
   

  

 Make the business case for the recommended semantic layer solution and contribute meaningfully to sales, pre\-sales, estimation, proposal inputs, and solution shaping activities.
   

  

 Provide thought leadership on technology trends, innovation opportunities, limitations, risks, delivery concerns, and practical adoption of knowledge graphs, semantic AI, LLM grounding, RAG, and agentic systems.
   

  

 Design, evaluate, and maintain ontologies, schemas, standards, and reusable engineering patterns, while guiding teams on data model quality and implementation methods.
   

  

 Lead a team or workstream within a larger program, mentor engineers, review design/code/configuration, and guide adoption of new methodologies, model building techniques, and algorithms.
   

  

 Collaborate across business and technical teams to drive end\-to\-end delivery for the assigned scope and demonstrate value to business and technology stakeholders.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field.
   

  

 Minimum 3 years of experience with Knowledge Graph technologies such as RDF, SPARQL, LPG, SHACL, OWL, graph query languages, schema design, ontology management, and KG curation.
   

  

 Minimum 3 years of experience in schema design, ontology management, semantic modeling, taxonomy management, metadata management, and knowledge graph curation.
   

  

 Minimum 3 years of experience designing and developing Knowledge Graph solutions and graph\-based ML models across functional and technical workstreams.
   

  

 Minimum 2 years of experience implementing end\-to\-end data pipelines for AI applications, especially LLM\-enabled or enterprise knowledge applications, with hands\-on design and configuration.
   

  

 Minimum 4 years of experience with relational databases, object stores, graph databases such as Stardog, Neo4j, Amazon Neptune or equivalent, and vector databases.
   

  

 Minimum 2 years of experience leading a team or workstream within a larger program.
   

  

 Experience collaborating with engineering, research, product, domain, client\-facing, and cross\-functional teams across multiple time zones.
   

  

**Required Skills/ Experience**
 Hands\-on experience building Azure\-based knowledge engineering solutions with Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse/Fabric, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, AKS, Microsoft Purview, Entra ID, APIs, and Azure Monitor.
   

  

 Strong Python experience with frameworks and tools such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, PySpark, SQL, SPARQL, SHACL, Apache Airflow, Apache NiFi, and ETL/ELT pipeline tooling.
   

  

 Practical knowledge of NLP and search techniques including entity extraction, entity resolution, semantic search, prompt engineering, LLM grounding, and enterprise\-scale LLM applications.
   

  

 Ability to design and implement scalable graph ingestion, ontology/schema pipelines, semantic layers, vector search/retrieval patterns, RAG pipelines, and governed knowledge services.
   

  

 Strong collaboration, technical leadership, delivery ownership, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills.
   

  

 Good to Have Skills
   

  

 2\+ years of hands\-on experience with cloud platforms, with Azure specialization and exposure to AWS or GCP in multi\-cloud environments.
   

  

 Azure certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Data Engineer, Azure AI Engineer, or related credentials.
   

  

 Industry experience in BFSI, healthcare, retail, telecom, manufacturing, energy, public sector, or life sciences, including domain ontologies, data models, compliance needs, and knowledge\-driven use cases.
   

  

 External client\-facing consulting experience, proposal support, solution shaping, or pre\-sales exposure.
   

  

 Advanced degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline broad exposure to diverse ML techniques and agentic systems.

* Perform deep execution plan analysis using Oracle SQL Monitor, SQLTXPLAIN, AWR, ASH, and other diagnostic tools.
* Optimize Azure\-hosted applications and services interacting with Oracle databases through enhanced connection pooling, batch processing, and integration patterns.
* Design scalable data integration frameworks leveraging Azure Data Factory and cloud\-native technologies.
* Improve database availability, scalability, reliability, and disaster recovery capabilities.
* Collaborate with application developers to embed database performance best practices within software development lifecycles.
* Lead database modernization and migration initiatives across cloud and hybrid environments.
* Establish database governance standards, performance benchmarks, and architectural best practices.

title: Senior Database Reliability Engineer
description:
**Location: Pune**
* Are you curious, excited by experimentation and always looking to innovate?
* Do you want to work in embedded payments where you can keep learning and developing whilst getting hands\-on experience?
* Do you want to have the opportunity to play an important role in a rapidly growing and exciting Fintech business?


 If so, we would love to connect and collaborate!
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Modulr is the payments automation platform that streamlines money movement with accuracy, control and reliability — built to scale. We process more than 200m transactions and over £180bn in payment value on an annualised basis, and we’re trusted by over 6,000 businesses from fast\-growing SMEs to global enterprises.
   

  

 We automate how money moves into and out of a business — payroll, supplier payments, spend management and payment collection — through a single platform, connected to the accounting and payroll systems finance teams already use and underpinned by principal memberships of Visa and Mastercard and direct access to central bank infrastructure.
   

  

 As a regulated payments provider with over a decade of experience, we’re the platform finance teams trust to run mission\-critical operations. Modulr is backed by PayPal, FIS, General Atlantic, Blenheim Chalcot, Frog Capital and Highland Europe, with over 400 employees across London, Edinburgh, Amsterdam, Mumbai and Pune.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Modulr is a B2B embedded\-payments platform operating at scale in a regulated environment. As we evolve our core data architecture, we’re hiring our first dedicated Database Reliability Engineer to raise the operational resilience of our payments platform.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role for someone who thinks like a Site Reliability Engineer but has deep database expertise — someone who wants to make a large, busy production estate observable, diagnosable, and safe to operate, and to be the database voice that shapes how we scale. It carries a clear path toward a data\-architecture mandate as the platform matures.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the reliability, performance, and observability of our production databases (primarily PostgreSQL / Amazon Aurora), so that issues are seen and understood in minutes, not hours.
* Lead deep\-dive diagnosis of production incidents — query performance, lock and wait\-event analysis, connection\-pool behaviour, blocking sessions — and turn findings into lasting fixes and runbooks.
* Build proactive guardrails: query and statement timeouts, connection\-pool standards, slow\-query and contention alerting, capacity and saturation monitoring.
* Partner with engineering squads to design schemas, indexes, and access patterns that scale, and to enforce safe database practices in their services.
* Contribute the database\-reliability perspective to significant platform\-evolution work, including separation of read and write paths and the decomposition of shared database components.
* Improve our database observability tooling and dashboards so reliability is measurable and trends are visible before they become incidents.
* Help embed a culture of operational excellence, blameless post\-incident review, and continuous improvement.


**Person Specification**
**Essential**
* Substantial hands\-on experience operating production PostgreSQL (Aurora / RDS a strong plus) at meaningful scale.
* Genuine SRE mindset: comfortable with observability tooling, metrics and tracing, alerting, automation, and infrastructure\-as\-code — not just database administration.
* Demonstrable strength in performance diagnosis: reading query plans, identifying lock contention and blocking, resolving connection\-pool exhaustion, and tuning for throughput and latency.
* Experience supporting high\-availability, low\-tolerance systems where correctness and uptime both matter.
* Clear, calm communicator who can lead a live incident and explain root cause to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Scripting/automation ability (e.g. Python, Bash) and working familiarity with AWS and Kubernetes\-based environments.


**Desired**
* Exposure to payments, fintech, or other regulated, high\-availability domains.
* Experience with data\-observability or lineage tooling and with connection\-management layers such as PgBouncer / RDS Proxy.
* Familiarity with decomposing monolithic databases and introducing read/write separation.


**ModInclusion**
 Modulr is a leading fintech platform providing Payments Automation and enterprise payment solutions. We serve high\-growth businesses across multiple verticals including Lending, Travel, Banking, and Core Business Payments, operating across India, the UK, Europe, and beyond. Our mission is to simplify and automate payments for our customers, and we're building a diverse, talented team to support that mission. Our people are central to our success, and we're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

title: EYP - DnA - Assistant Manager

**The opportunity**
 We are looking for Associate Manager \- Data Engineering. In this role you will be coming up with design specifications, documentation, and development of data migration mappings and transformations for a modern Data Warehouse set up/data mart creation and define robust ETL processing to collect and scrub both structured and unstructured data providing self\-serve capabilities (OLAP) in order to create impactful decision analytics reporting.

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Architecture design and implementation experience with medium to complex on\-prem to cloud migrations with any of the major cloud platforms (preferably AWS/Azure/GCP)

* 3\+ years hands\-on experience in various Azure services preferred – Azure Data Factory, Kafka, Azure Data Explorer, Storage, Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Analysis Services \& Databricks

**What We Look For**

* An opportunity to be a part of market\-prominent, multi\-disciplinary team of 1400 \+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY SaT practices globally with prominent businesses across a range of industries


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. title: Implementation Engineer II
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category\-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high\-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Implementation Engineer II partners with government customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life, owning the most complex product configurations and the underlying data migrations across a portfolio of implementations. This role leads requirements validation, configuration and data reviews, platform configuration and testing, data migration and reconciliation, and user enablement, guiding customers through the full deployment journey from kickoff to go\-live while setting the technical quality bar for the team.
   

  

 Acting as a trusted advisor with deep product knowledge and advanced data and database expertise, the Implementation Engineer II understands each customer's goals, pain points, and workflows, and translates them into scalable, maintainable solutions. This role blends hands\-on technical delivery, including data transformation and migration (ETL), and scripting, with a consultative, customer\-first approach.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the data migration, configuration, and testing of OpenGov cloud software for the most complex government implementations across the United States
* Perform configuration reviews across the team, validating that platform setup aligns with documented requirements, product best practices, and long\-term maintainability before go\-live
* Perform data reviews, validating migrated data for completeness, accuracy, and integrity, and reconciling source\-to\-target data so the product reflects trusted, audit\-ready customer data
* Own complex customer data migration end to end, including database schema mapping, ETL tool configuration, and scripting, to ensure the product is populated with accurate, validated data
* Confirm and pressure\-test customer requirements across both configuration and data, resolving ambiguity and advising customers on the optimal solution design
* Design and execute comprehensive test scenarios that validate the configuration and migrated data produce accurate, expected outcomes prior to go\-live
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for government / customer stakeholder like Budget Directors, IT personnel, and decision\-makers, guiding them through the deployment and integration process
* Identify recurring customer pain points and partner with cross\-functional teams to simplify, enhance, and automate processes that improve customer workflows and delivery efficiency
* Define and improve implementation standards, templates, playbooks, and reusable tooling that increase the quality, consistency, and speed of delivery
* Partner closely with the Project Management, Customer Success Management, Data/Integration, and Product teams to ensure a consistent customer experience, and channel field feedback into the product roadmap


**Requirements And Preferred Experience**
* 3 to 6 years of experience in software implementation, data migration, or technical consulting, ideally with enterprise or SaaS products
* 3\+ years of hands\-on SQL scripting experience, including complex queries, data transformation, and reconciliation
* 3\+ years of Python, or similar, scripting experience for automation and data processing
* Deep experience with database technologies and with ETL and data\-migration concepts and tools, including schema design and performance considerations
* Experience implementing AI\-driven solutions for automation, workflow optimization, and data\-driven insights, leveraging modern frameworks and AI models
* Demonstrated ability to deliver complex implementations end to end and to mentor or provide technical guidance to less\-experienced engineers
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with a strong teamwork and customer\-service mentality across executive and technical stakeholders
* Strong attention to detail, with the proven ability to validate, reconcile, and sign off on data and configuration for accuracy
* Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing product and respond strategically to evolving customer needs
* Bachelor's degree in a technical, or related field


**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
 At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
   

  

**Opportunity to Innovate**
 The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
   

  

**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
 This isn’t your typical 9\-to\-5 job; we operate in a fast\-paced, results\-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800\+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
   

  

**A Place to Make Your Mark**
 We pride ourselves on our performance\-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head\-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
   

  

**Benefits That Work For You**
 Enjoy an award\-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
   

  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: Data Engineering Lead
description:
At SiteMinder we believe the individual contributions of our employees are what drive our success. That’s why we hire and encourage diverse teams that include and respect a variety of voices, identities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. Our diverse and inclusive culture enables our employees to bring their unique selves to work and be proud of doing so. It’s in our differences that we will keep revolutionising the way for our customers. We are better together!
   

  

**What We Do…**
 We’re people who love technology but know that hoteliers just want things to be simple. So since 2006 we’ve been constantly innovating our world\-leading hotel commerce platform to help accommodation owners find and book more guests online \- quickly and simply.
   

  

 We’ve helped everyone from boutique hotels to big chains, enabling travellers to book igloos, cabins, castles, holiday parks, campsites, pubs, resorts, Airbnbs, and everything in between.
   

  

 And today, we’re the world’s leading open hotel commerce platform, supporting 56,000 hotels in 150\+ countries \- with over 140 million reservations processed by SiteMinder’s technology every year.
   

  

**About The Data Engineering Lead Role…**
 We are looking for a hands\-on Data Engineering Lead to provide technical direction and people leadership for a small team of data engineers. You will help shape the evolution of SiteMinder’s cloud data platform while continuing to contribute directly to the design and delivery of data engineering solutions.
   

  

 This is a player\-coach role. You will spend approximately 70% of your time on data engineering projects and 30% on Data Operations, reliability, and support. You will work across Databricks, Snowflake, dbt, AWS, Terraform, Python, SQL, and related technologies.
   

  

 You will partner with engineering, product, finance, commercial, and analytics stakeholders to turn business needs into trusted, maintainable data solutions. You will also help establish the engineering standards, operating practices, and team capabilities needed to scale our data platform.

**People leadership**

**Delivery and stakeholder partnership**

* Build strong functional knowledge of SiteMinder’s systems and business processes, including applications such as Salesforce and Zuora
* Work effectively with geographically distributed teams and communicate technical decisions clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Participate in data discovery, deep\-dive analysis, and investigation of complex data issues, communicating findings and recommended actions clearly


**Data Operations and reliability**
* Help operate and support production data pipelines, datasets, and integrations within agreed service levels.
* Establish effective monitoring, alerting, incident response, root\-cause analysis, and problem\-management practices.
* Improve data quality through automated testing, validation, reconciliation, lineage, and documentation.
* Manage operational requests and prioritise ad hoc analysis based on business impact and urgency.
* Identify recurring operational issues and convert them into sustainable engineering improvements rather than manual workarounds


**What You Have…**
**Technical Experience**
* Significant professional experience in data engineering, including experience leading technical delivery or mentoring engineers
* Strong hands\-on experience with cloud data platforms, including Databricks and/or Snowflake, and production experience with dbt
* Experience designing and implementing data platforms using medallion or comparable layered architecture patterns
* Strong Python and SQL skills, with practical experience writing, testing, debugging, and optimising production data pipelines
* Experience with data modelling, dimensional modelling, data warehousing, fact and dimension tables, slowly changing dimensions, and analytical data products
* Experience building and operating complete ETL or ELT processes, including ingestion, transformation, testing, deployment, and monitoring
* Practical experience with Terraform or another infrastructure\-as\-code approach
* Experience building bespoke integrations using Python, REST APIs, or similar technologies
* Strong understanding of data reliability, observability, security, access control, and cost management
* Experience working with AWS data services and the ability to choose appropriate services for a given use case


**Leadership and collaboration**
* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, make clear technical decisions, and create alignment across teams
* Experience coaching engineers and raising engineering standards across a team
* Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder\-management skills
* A structured and analytical approach to problem\-solving, with sound judgment when working independently
* Experience working effectively with geographically distributed and culturally diverse teams
* A practical, delivery\-focused mindset suited to a growing technology organisation


**Nice to have**
* Experience with streaming or event\-driven data platforms such as Kafka, Kinesis, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with AWS services such as Glue, EMR, and Kinesis
* Experience with Spark and large\-scale distributed data processing
* Experience with change data capture, near\-real\-time ingestion, or integration with OLTP systems
* Experience with data governance, data contracts, metadata management, lineage, or master data concepts
* Experience supporting a migration between data platforms, such as Snowflake and Databricks
* Experience in the SaaS, travel, hospitality, or marketplace sectors


**Our Perks \& Benefits…**

* Generous parental (including secondary) leave policy

 When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any adjustments you may need during the interview process. We encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply.

This role is critical to the integrity and scalability of our reporting landscape.

* Define and govern KPIs and performance metrics for your business area, ensuring consistent definitions across teams and regions

* Exposure to data governance frameworks and metric catalogues
* Prior experience supporting executive\-level reporting or board\-level dashboards
* Background in construction technology or field operations analytics is a plus

title: Senior Vice President - Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms (CIP)
description:
**Job Description**
 Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms (CIP), Pune
   

  

 Senior Vice President
   

  

 Pune, India
   

  

**About Infrastructure Technology**
 The Global Infrastructure organization builds and maintains the critical technology backbone that enables Jefferies to operate at scale, delivering secure, resilient, and high\-performing IT services that power the business. We drive innovation through solutions such as cloud and hybrid adoption, network resiliency, platform modernization, and automation. The organization is structured into several specialized sub\-domains: Core Infrastructure Platform, Public Cloud, Digital Workspace, Networking, Telecom \& Multimedia, and International Infrastructure. Our teams collaborate globally to ensure Jefferies’ technology platforms are highly available, secure, scalable, and cost\-effective.
   

  

**Core Infrastructure Platforms**
 The Core Infrastructure Platforms function lays the foundation for Jefferies’ IT, designing, operating, and optimizing the essential compute, storage, operating systems, and database platforms that support all business\-critical applications. Our mission is to deliver secure, resilient, and high\-performance datacenter and cloud solutions for global operations.
   

  

 Organized into four teams, Global Systems Engineering, Unix Engineering, Windows Engineering, and Database Engineering, this group drives operational excellence, security, high availability, compliance, and continuous improvement across our technology estate.
   

  

 By championing automation, standardization, and proactive monitoring, and by working closely with application, security, and business teams, we ensure our environments are robust, stable, and scalable. Through this collaborative approach and a relentless focus on modernization, Jefferies’ infrastructure remains agile and adaptable, ready to meet the evolving needs of our global business.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Jefferies is seeking a dynamic, hands\-on, and strategic Senior Vice President (SVP), Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms (Pune). This executive technical leader will lead automation, operations, and modernization of Jefferies’ platform stack, with a focus on critical platform domains: databases, virtualization, storage, backup, compute, and Unix/Windows server infrastructure. Based in Pune, India, the SVP will lead the Pune CIPteam and be accountable for technical excellence, operational resilience, and end\-to\-end Pune led delivery supporting the US, EMEA and APAC estate. This role reports to the Head of GCC, Pune (primary) and the Global Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms, Jersey City (secondary).
   

  

 This is not a pure management or “middle\-layer” role. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on domain expert who remains technically current, acts as a trusted escalation point and decision\-maker, and independently resolves complex infrastructure and operational challenges rather than simply escalating them.
   

  

 Success in this role comes from earning the trust of engineers and global business stakeholders through demonstrated technical mastery, incident command, and the delivery of solutions that enable strategic business outcomes. The position requires deep technical expertise paired with proven people leadership to build, mentor, and scale high\-performing teams supporting 24/7 capital markets operations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Global Platform Leadership: partner with global leads on the vision, engineering standards, and operational governance for Jefferies’ core infrastructure stack: database, virtualization, storage, backup, compute, Unix/Linux, and Windows server platforms, across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
* Local Management of the Infrastructure Team: direct managerial responsibilities for Infrastructure Technology team members located in the Jefferies Pune office (Networks, Telecom, Digital Workplace, Cloud, CIP, Service Delivery).
* Modernization \& Cloud/Hybrid Adoption: Drive modernization, cloud/hybrid adoption, automation\-first delivery, and standardization across all domains, balancing operational excellence with innovation and optimization. Lead strategic integration and optimal workload placement between on\-premises and cloud resources, as business and regulatory requirements permit.
* Hands\-on Technical Escalation: Serve as the final point of escalation and technical incident lead during major outages, performance, or security incidents. Analyze real\-time symptoms, ask the right diagnostic questions, and guide teams towards root\-cause resolution.
* Solution Delivery: Architect and deliver practical, high\-impact solutions for business and application teams, actively collaborating with CIO leadership, BU leads, and local metro SVPs/VPs worldwide.
* Operational Resilience: Own and continuously improve resilience, high\-availability, recovery, and compliance strategies across the global platform estate.
* Global Team Development: Partner with global leads in NYC, London, and HK to cultivate a high\-performing, distributed team of engineers and architects, primarily based in India. You will mentor leaders and engineers, promote end\-to\-end ownership, and develop problem\-solving capability.
* Stakeholder Partnership: Partner with business units, application teams, and senior platform leaders to align technical priorities, communicate platform direction, and enable local\-global business outcomes.
* Technical Standards \& Documentation: Author, maintain, and enforce robust operational standards, SLAs, playbooks, and knowledge base for platform operations and incident response.
* Post\-Incident Review \& Learning: Lead technical post\-mortems and deep\-dives, drive remediation, and foster a culture of continuous technical learning.
* Regulatory \& Risk Alignment: Execute robust security, compliance, vulnerability management, and audit readiness for mission\-critical infrastructure in a highly regulated financial services environment.


**Mandatory Qualifications \& Skills**
* Experience:
+ 15\+ years in IT infrastructure/platform engineering and operations, with at least 5 years in global technical leadership (financial services or complex enterprise IT preferred).
+ Proven recent, hands\-on experience with at least three of: database platforms (SQL/Oracle/etc), virtualization (VMware/Hyper\-V/KVM, Nutanix), storage (SAN/NAS), backup/DR, Unix/Linux, and Windows server engineering and operations.
+ Track record as a solution owner, not just a conduit, able to independently architect and deliver technical outcomes in critical environments.

* Core Competencies:
+ Deep technical expertise, able to lead troubleshooting, ask the right questions, synthesize technical indicators, and command resolution during platform issues and outages.
+ Domain credibility, regarded by engineers and senior IT partners as the go\-to technical escalation contact.
+ Record of driving platform modernization, cloud/hybrid/cloud adoption, automation, and cost/risk optimization.
+ Strong foundation in regulatory, compliance, and operational risk management for infrastructure.
+ Executive presence, able to command trust in both technical and business forums, and partner with C\-levels, application owners, and metro engineering leaders.
+ Outstanding stakeholder management, communication, prioritization, and conflict resolution skills, on both local (India) and global scales.
+ Experience designing and enforcing technical standards, SLAs, and incident management frameworks.

* Certifications (optional, but valued):
+ Recognized certifications (RHCE, MCSE, VMware, Nutanix, NetApp, AWS/Azure/GCP, ITIL, etc.)


**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent required; Master’s degree preferred.


**What Success Looks Like**
 The SVP delivers a world\-class platform that serves as a resilient, secure, continuously modernizing backbone for all Jefferies business applications, across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. You lead actively, commanding incidents, delivering solutions, and growing your team’s technical and operational capability. You are trusted by engineers as a technical authority, by CIO/BU leaders as a business partner, and by the enterprise as the leader who enables robust, scalable solutions tightly aligned with the business's needs.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer:** 
 Jefferies values diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
   

  

**About Us**
 Jefferies is a leading global, full\-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. With more than 40 offices around the world, we offer insights and expertise to investors, companies, and governments.
   

  

 At Jefferies, we believe that diversity fosters creativity, innovation and thought leadership through the infusion of new ideas and perspectives. We have made a commitment to building a culture that provides opportunities for all employees regardless of our differences and supports a workforce that is reflective of the communities where we work and live. As a result, we are able to pool our collective insights and intelligence to provide fresh and innovative thinking for our clients.
   

  

 Jefferies is an equal employment opportunity employer, and takes affirmative action to ensure that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, gender, pregnancy, age, physical or mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, genetic information, reproductive health decisions, or any other factor protected by applicable law. We are committed to hiring the most qualified applicants and complying with all federal, state, and local equal employment opportunity laws. As part of this commitment, Jefferies will extend reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities, as required by applicable law.

title: Data Architect
description:
**Shape the Future with Us.**
 At Lubrizol, we’re bringing to life the chemistry behind clean water, efficient transportation, reliable infrastructure, critical medicines, and the products people rely on every day through science, sustainability, and a culture of inclusion.
   

  

 As part of our global team, you’ll be empowered to make a real impact \- on your career, your community, and the world around you.
   

  

**Data Architect – Data Intelligence**
 We are seeking an experienced Data Architect to join our Data Intelligence team. This role will work in close partnership with cross functional teams to design, optimize, and govern the enterprise data ecosystem. The successful candidate will bring strong expertise in SAP and Microsoft data technologies, designing sustainable data architecture in data platforms while also supporting robust integration, scalability, and alignment with enterprise business strategies.
   

  

 The Data Architect will play a key role in shaping our enterprise\-wide data strategy, ensuring data assets are well\-structured, secure, and accessible to support analytics, reporting, and innovation across the organization.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design and maintain data models, data flows, and integration architectures that align with enterprise strategy and enable interoperability across systems.
* Establish and enforce data governance, quality, and security practices across structured and unstructured data assets.
* Provide data architectural leadership in designing ETL/ELT processes, data warehouses, data lakes, and analytics platforms.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their requirements and translate them into technical solutions that align with the overall enterprise data strategy and architecture.
* Parter with platform and engineering teams to ensure data platforms support data ingestion, ETL processes, advanced analytics, reporting, AI/ML, and business intelligence initiatives.
* Stay current on emerging Microsoft, SAP, and cloud\-native data technologies and assess their potential application within the organization.
* Support the evaluation, selection, and implementation of data management and integration technologies, with a focus on Microsoft Azure data services, SQL Server, Power BI, and SAP HANA/SAP BW.
* Supports the designs and implementation of the ETL process from various sources into the organization’s data systems.
* Define and enforce data governance, quality, and security practices across structured and unstructured data assets and platforms to ensure consistency, scalability, and maintainability.
* Translates high\-level business requirements into data models and appropriate metadata, test data, and data quality standards


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related field.
* 12\+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, data modeling or enterprise architecture roles.
* Experience working in manufacturing and/or process manufacturing environments.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP data ecosystems (e.g., SAP HANA, SAP BW, SAP DataSphere, SAP Data Services, SAP integration with Microsoft platforms).
* Expertise in Microsoft data technologies (e.g., Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory, MS Fabric, SQL Server, Power BI).
* Experience with data lakehouse architectures and modern data platforms.
* Strong knowledge of data modeling (conceptual, logical, physical) and database design.
* Strong knowledge of SAP data structures, CDS views, models and use in downstream applications, especially for analytics.
* Experience with cloud\-based data platforms (Azure and Microsoft Fabric preferred).
* Familiarity with data governance frameworks, metadata management, and master data management (MDM).
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to lead cross\-functional teams and influence data strategy at the enterprise level.


**Preferred Skills**
* Understanding of AI/ML data requirements and enabling infrastructure.
* Knowledge of data security, compliance, and privacy regulations (GDPR, HIPAA, etc.).
* TOGAF, DAMA, or similar enterprise architecture or data management certifications.


 Lubrizol: Imagined for Life. Enabled by Science. ™ Delivered by You. For nearly 100 years, The Lubrizol Corporation, a Berkshire Hathaway company, has been at the forefront of innovation to enhance everyday life, advance mobility, and make the modern world work better. Our specialty chemistry solutions—from engine oils, performance coatings, and skincare to medical devices and plumbing systems —are powered by the expertise, passion, and commitment of people like you. We tackle the world’s toughest challenges with science\-based solutions, deeply understanding our customers to deliver innovative chemistry and differentiated value. Our inclusive culture, dedication to safety, and incredible global talent drive our success. Our solutions meet the evolving needs of the modern world—brought to life by science and, most importantly, delivered by you. Whether you're in the lab, on the production floor, or in the office, you'll be part of a team around the world that empowers you to think boldly, drive results, and contribute to solutions that shape a better, more sustainable future.  We win because of you. Let’s build the future together.

title: Senior Operations Support Engineer (Integration Platform)
description:
We are looking for an enthusiastic and inquisitive
 **Senior Operations Support Engineer (Integration Platform)** 
 who will be responsible for operational management, support, monitoring, deployment, security, and continuous improvement of enterprise integration platforms. Ensures reliable and secure operation of more than 2,000 integrations and 1,200 supplier connections while providing operational support, onboarding, and incident management.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities –**
* Own the operational management of Production and Non\-Production Integration Platforms supporting 2,000\+ integrations and 1,200 supplier connections.
* Manage Integration infrastructure administration, including installation, configuration, upgrades, patching, platform maintenance, and environment standards.
* Manage application, supplier, developer, and user onboarding, including access control, security permissions, and compliance alignment.
* Ensure high availability, performance, reliability, scalability, and governance compliance across Azure, AWS, and on\-premise integration environments.
* Oversee SSL certificates, authentication mechanisms, security configurations, secure connectivity, and platform security controls.
* Incident management, root cause analysis (RCA), change management, major incident resolution, and preventive improvement actions to ensure SLA compliance.
* Coordinate and drive platform deployments, environment migrations, disaster recovery (DR), and business continuity activities.
* Provide third\-level support and technical escalation ownership for business\-critical integrations and platform services.
* Lead communication during major incidents or outages impacting suppliers, trading partners, business users, and internal stakeholders.
* Maintain and improve platform documentation, operational procedures, support knowledge bases, and governance standards.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, development, QA, infrastructure, security teams, product teams, suppliers, and external vendors to ensure stable integration services.
* Translate business and technical requirements into supportable integration solutions, technical specifications, and operational designs.
* Design, develop, maintain, and improve scalable, secure, and supportable integrations, APIs, EDI flows, mappings, transformations, and file transfer solutions.
* Build and improve CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, monitoring, alerting, and operational automation.
* Promote integration standards, platform governance, best practices, continuous improvement, and service reliability across the team.
* Coach and guide junior engineers, support knowledge sharing, and contribute to capability development within the integration support team


**Education Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/MIS, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field required.


**Knowledge \& Skills REQUIRED**
* Minimum 6\+ years of relevant work experience –
+ Integration Platforms \- BizTalk Server: Managed File Transfer (GoAnywhere MFT), and Processes, Integration Principles and Best Practices, Integration Monitoring and Alerting
+ Infrastructure \& Operating Systems – Linux Administration , Windows Server, SSL Certificate Management
+ Databases \- SQL Server
+ EDI Platforms and Processes
+ OFTP2, Event\-Driven Architecture
+ Messaging Patterns
+ EDI \& B2B Integration, EDI Standards (EDIFACT, X12\)
+ Mapping Development, Schema Development
+ DevOps \& Tools \- Azure DevOps, CI/CD Pipelines


**Knowledge \& Skills Good To Have**
* API Management (Apigee), Azure (Integration) Service, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Service Bus
* AWS (EC2, S3, RDS), Networking Fundamentals, Security \& Authentication
* Databases \- PostgreSQL
* Automation \& Scripting – PowerShell, Bash / Linux Shell Scripting, Python
* GitHub
* Visual Studio Code, Service Management Tools (ServiceNow, Jira)


**Competencies And Behaviors**
* Incident Management, Problem Management and Change Management
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and written and verbal English communication skills \& adjusting in other culture
* Able to work effectively in a team environment with little or no supervision.
* Able to work effectively with a remote team
* Able to prioritize and track multiple initiatives concurrently.
* Embody and promote PACCAR values of Teamwork, Continuous Improvement, Commitment, Openness, and Learning.
